title: Kollegio: MVP plan
tagline: An HR agent for small German start-ups: employees report leave, sickness and hours in a chat, the CEO approves, and the tax firm gets one clean monthly report.
description: Kollegio takes routine HR admin off the desk of start-up CEOs who have 4–10 employees and no HR person. This project is the product work behind the MVP, run end to end as product manager and builder. Discovery came first: six interviews with four CEOs, an employee and a tax consultant showed that leave requests arrive by Teams, Slack and email, balances live in Excel, and the monthly handoff to the tax firm costs CEOs hours and causes errors. A competitor scan and a product strategy followed, then a roadmap and a PRD with 40 requirements and 12 user stories, published to Jira. The working prototype lets employees ask for leave in plain language. A Claude agent proposes the dates, skips weekends and public holidays, shows the balance before and after, and flags colleagues who are away. The CEO approves in one place, approves hourly staff's weeks with one click with a Minijob earnings-limit warning, and sends the monthly absence report. The prototype runs on my own server for in-person usability tests in November 2026; the MVP is planned for December, followed by a pilot with start-ups in January and February 2027.
